moves.name: Bodyweight squat

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan at the bottom of a squat

cues: Feet shoulder width, weight on your heels.
Sit back like there's a chair behind you.

moves.name: Push-up

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan at the bottom of a push-up on handles

cues: Bring your chest all the way down.
Too hard? Do them from your knees.

moves.name: Spiderman plank

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan pushing up from his elbows

cues: Start in a plank on your elbows.
Push up to a push-up position, one side, then the other.
Stay perfectly straight. No butt in the air.
